summary: MGE Energy filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a mixed shelf takedown of 3,300,331 common shares. The offering includes 990,099 shares issued directly and forward sale agreements for 2,310,232 shares via Morgan Stanley, Bank of America, and JPMorgan, netting approximately $72.2M initially (or up to $168.4M upon full physical settlement within ~20 months). The public price is $75.75/share ($80.80 close on May 6, 2026). This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. No board recommendation, advisors, or premium are disclosed.
